Benefit Claim Details

Automatic Recommendation

Eligibility
Yes
Reason
The applicant qualifies for SNAP benefits under the provided guidelines. For a household size of 3,
the maximum allowable gross monthly income is $3,350, and the applicant's gross monthly income
is $900, which is below that threshold. Using the available information, no allowable deductions
were provided, so net monthly income is treated as $900. The maximum monthly benefit for a
household of 3 is $785. Fifteen percent of net income is $135, and subtracting that from $785 results
in a monthly benefit amount of $650.
Monthly Benefit Calculation
650

Fraud Risk Analysis

Valid
A residency record was found for SSN 703-48-9234 with address 123 Main St, Springfield, MO 65803.
The stored address included a trailing space in the street field ("123 Main St "), which is a formatting
difference only and does not affect the match. Address, City, State, and ZIP all match the declared
address.
Income
valid
Paystub shows monthly income of $900.00 for Adrian Cole (Employee ID/SSN 703-48-9234), which
matches existing records monthly income of $900.

Missouri Department of
Social Services

Application for Supplemental Nutrition
Assistance Program (SNAP)

To apply:
• You have the right to apply for SNAP benefits at any time.
• If an interview is required, it can be completed by phone or in
  person. An interview is required in most cases.
• Family Support Division (FSD) will attempt to call you, if
  you provided a phone number on the application, the next
  business day after your application is registered to complete
  an interview. Answering this phone call is the quickest way to
  complete your interview.
• If you did not provide a phone number, or if you are unable to
  complete your interview at the time we call, please call (855)
  823-4908 to complete your interview or visit an FSD office to
  complete this as soon as possible. (Review the next page for
  more information about what to do after you've submitted
  your SNAP application).
• We may ask you for proof of some of the information you give
  to FSD.
• Please write as neatly as possible.

Ways to return a SNAP application:
Upload:
mydssupload.mo.gov
Mail:
Family Support
Division PO Box 2700
Jefferson City, MO 65102
In Person:
Find an office:
dss.mo.gov/offices.htm
Fax:
573-526-9400

Date of application:
Benefits are provided from the date FSD receives your application, which must contain your name, address and
signature. Please complete sections 2 through 6 to help FSD process your application faster.
If approved, your SNAP benefits are provided from the date FSD receives your application. This is your filing date. If you
[...] are in an institution and apply for SNAP benefits and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) at the same time, your filing
[...] date is the date of release from the institution.
extraction.description: The screenshot shows a UiPath human validation/action screen for Benefit Claims Processing. The Benefit Application tab is active, displaying benefit claim details, an automatic eligibility recommendation, monthly benefit calculation, and fraud risk analysis on the left. A PDF viewer on the right shows the applicant’s SNAP application document, while Approve and Deny action buttons are available at the top.
extraction.step_instructions: Review the Automatic Recommendation and Fraud Risk Analysis sections on the left. Review the SNAP application document in the PDF viewer on the right and use the Supporting Docs tab if additional evidence is needed. Click on Approve to accept the recommended benefit claim decision, or click on Deny to reject it.
